name: @djgrant/github/issue-attachment
description: Uploads a local file (image, video, PDF) to GitHub as a user attachment through an issue's comment box and returns its github.com/user-attachments URL, ready to paste into an issue or PR body. Nothing is posted: the comment box is cleared first and the upload only fills its draft.

writes: GitHub user attachments (uploads a new copy of the file on every call)

wait.appears: textarea[placeholder='Use Markdown to format your comment']

perform.fill: textarea[placeholder='Use Markdown to format your comment']

perform.drop: textarea[placeholder='Use Markdown to format your comment']
